A '''[[Shaman of the Whills/Legends|Shaman of the Whills]]''' was an ancient, holy individual who discovered the ability to survive after death<ref name="Shaman of the Whills CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|143|Shaman of the Whills}}</ref> as a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]]. The shaman shared this secret with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who in turn taught the ability to [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="Force spirit CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|287|Force spirit}}</ref>
